rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone takes an action personally or is offended by it.

example.english: I resent him saying I’m useless in front of so many people.

rows.note: Use this when the resentment is about unfair or unacceptable treatment and the person feels indignant.

example.english: I resent having my pay docked when he was the one who was late.

rows.note: Use this when resentment is expressed as stronger, more immediate anger toward someone.

example.english: I really resent you for betraying me like that.
